AK reports mail, early and prov at HOUSE-DISTRICT level for all 402 precincts (31.1% of the vote mass), so eday is the only mode with a precinct-level cell -- a mail or early equation would be fitted on no precinct and predicted onto every one. The district-level modes come back through the county add-on, not through precinct cells. 2022 split was eday 66.6 / mail 19.3 / early 14.2, which is what that add-on has to account for. With USE_MODE_EXISTS=0 set modes=mail|early|eday to reproduce the old behaviour.
